implementation_summary: Adds OpenClPromptLayerInput/OpenClPromptLayerResult and run_opencl_prompt_layer_forward on the existing OpenCL layer backend.
Copies bounded active prompt rows, PLE rows, attention mask, and position ids into the existing fixed-size OpenCL layer layout, then copies only active output rows back.
Extends C5 final hidden emission to run the scheduled 42 decoder layers in order over the bounded prompt stream.
Derives layer-specific PLE rows from the current hidden stream and prompt token ids for each layer.
Applies the rank-16 adapter at the adapter-site-policy declared post-layer site before exposing final hidden rows to chunked LM-head/NLL.
Leaves prediction JSONL writing as the next explicit boundary; no decoded prediction payload is written by this pathset.

design_lens_applied.stable_structure: frozen backbone tensors and PLE rows are stable structure consumed layer by layer
design_lens_applied.local_plasticity: rank-16 adapter is applied as a bounded local plasticity site at the declared residual layer boundary
design_lens_applied.error_signal: C5 loss remains teacher-forced answer-token NLL from real LM-head logits after final hidden stream emission
design_lens_applied.stop_condition: prediction payload emission remains blocked until a real prediction JSONL writer/decode boundary is implemented
